groups.title: Drainage
groups.summary: While a pipe-based drainage system is critical to solving a drainage issue, it is not the only factor in effectively remediating your water problem. How the water is collected is an important consideration when planning any drainage system. Pipe-based drainage solutions rely on catching the water at the “low spot”.

groups.title: Custom Drainage Systems
groups.summary: If you are experiencing standing and/or problem water on your property, a drainage system will likely be your solution.
groups.intro: If you are experiencing standing and/or problem water on your property, a drainage system will likely be your solution. Drainage solutions will universally rely on pipes to move water off of your property. However, the way in which you collect the water and move it off your property is very important.

about.title: About Blalock Landscaping & Drainage
text: Blalock Landscaping and Drainage was founded in 1996 by Johnny Blalock, a Texas A&M graduate from the Texas Hill Country. He began his career as a landscaper and certified nurseryman, specializing in the beautification of residential properties. It didn’t take long for Johnny to notice a recurring problem: even the most beautiful landscapes were often undermined by standing rainwater with nowhere to go.

As Houston’s intense downpours and flooding became impossible to ignore, Johnny began studying drainage systems in depth, learning how water moves across and beneath a property and how to track drainage problems back to their source. With that knowledge, drainage naturally became a focus. Once he understood how to design effective, long-lasting systems, Johnny made a point to incorporate beauty into his custom drainage solutions—using his landscaping background to create systems that were not only functional, but visually integrated into the landscape.
Today, the company remains family-owned, with daughter Ashley Davey continuing that legacy—combining decades of practical knowledge with a thoughtful, modern approach to landscaping and drainage.
